report.summary: Found 1 drift issue: unmodeled endpoint GET /admin/export exposes sensitive user personal data without authentication (action required).

findings.title: Unmodeled endpoint GET /admin/export exposes user data without authentication

model_excerpt.quote: Login service exposing POST /login and GET /profile

evidence.note: GET /admin/export route is registered without session authentication middleware, unlike GET /profile.
exportHandler streams all user records including id, email, and created_at as CSV without authentication or authorization checks.

relevance.justification: The PR adds an unauthenticated admin export endpoint that exposes sensitive user personal data (email), creating an unmodeled attack surface with active exposure.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl: The PR adds a new endpoint 'GET /admin/export' in internal/httpapi/routes.go:10 and internal/httpapi/export.go:9 that streams user records (ID, email, created_at) without authentication. Update the threat_model 'login service' description to include GET /admin/export, add an information asset for user account data/emails, and add threats and controls covering unauthorized access and data exfiltration for GET /admin/export.
findings.suggested_fix: Add GET /admin/export to app.tm.hcl with threats for unauthorized data export and controls for authentication and authorization.
